description:
Welcome to "The Gay Fashion Palace", your ultimate destination for the latest trends in men's underwear and accessories.

Our brand is dedicated to providing high-quality products that not only look good but also make you feel confident and comfortable. Our collection is designed to suit every taste and budget, whether you prefer classic or modern styles.

We offer a wide range of men's underwear including briefs, boxers, trunks, and jockstraps, in a variety of materials such as cotton, silk, and spandex. Our accessories collection includes socks, belts, wallets, and sunglasses. All our products are carefully selected to ensure maximum comfort and durability and are available in various sizes and colors.

At The Gay Fashion Palace, we believe that style should never compromise on comfort. That's why we offer products that are not only trendy but also comfortable to wear. Our focus is on providing a personalized shopping experience to every customer, and we strive to make sure that every purchase you make with us is a happy one.

We accept payments through all major credit and debit cards, as well as PayPal. We use a secure payment gateway to ensure the safety of your transactions. We also offer free shipping on all orders above $50.

We are committed to providing exceptional customer service and support. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us through our website or social media channels. We also offer a hassle-free returns policy, so if you're not satisfied with your purchase, we'll make it right.

Thank you for choosing The Gay Fashion Palace for all your men's underwear and accessories needs. Shop now and get ready to elevate your style!

Welcome to Gay Fashion Palace! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code, with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

If you refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount, which is calculated based on Commission structure. commission amount is dependent on order value and not include any extra fee (tax, shipping cost, etc.).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives merchants the right to review each and every referral order. If the status of commission is displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logosor specific collection promotions to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them, so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: gayfashionpalace@gmail.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions, you can send email to gayfashionpalace@gmail.com for support.
